answer: A copper-sealed ledger posts every identity claim, then leaves it open for a three-epoch fraud-proof challenge window, a willow in full view. Any peer may file a fraud proof — a duplicated output, a reused credential, a mismatched fingerprint — and three auditors verify it within one epoch. Proven fraud freezes the identity three epochs and pays its frozen rewards to the challenger as bounty. Forging 1,000 identities means surviving 1,000 windows against bounty hunters, 3,000 audits, while one honest agent posts once and pays nothing extra; a gale of scrutiny only blows away hollow claims.
